Do you still remember the first time you reversed the car out of the driveway on your own? That feeling is pure freedom. But for your parents, that moment may be one of the most terrifying of their lives. When you were a teenager, they had absolutely no way of knowing how fast you were driving, where you had gone, when you would arrive, or how safely you were driving. "No news is good news" — until you checked in, hope was all they had to rely on.

If you currently have a teenager who drives, treasure the fact that you no longer have to live in that age of constant worry. Although 2026 technology has plenty of drawbacks, HeyPolo is clearly an example of technology that makes driving safer for teenagers and life better overall.

HeyPolo is more than just an upgraded version of Apple's "Find My" service

HeyPolo is a family safety app that bundles real-time location sharing, arrival and departure notifications, SOS emergency alerts, and driving safety features all into one price. The driving features are what set it apart most from ordinary location-sharing apps (such as "Find My"). Every time your child gets behind the wheel, their driving behaviour is tracked and scored, so you can clearly see how they are performing: how fast they are going, whether they used their smartphone while driving, whether there was any hard braking or sudden acceleration, and whether any serious driving incident was detected.

The "driving score" rates each trip based on their actual driving behaviour, so you no longer have to guess whether your teenager is really driving safely. You can look at the data, have a serious conversation if the performance is poor, and as their driving habits improve, the score will gradually increase. Compared with anything the previous generation had at their disposal, this is far more useful in helping new licence holders improve their skills.

Crash detection, arrival notifications and more

HeyPolo can detect a collision and notify you automatically. Combined with arrival notifications — whether your child has arrived at school, at practice, at a friend's home, or back at the house, the system will send a trigger notification — you go from "hoping no news is good news" to actually knowing whether they are safe. You do not have to wait for them to arrive before they text or call you; you can know precisely when they get there, and that peace of mind is priceless for parents. HeyPolo updates the location every 5 seconds, so your location information is always accurate.

One price, shared by the whole family

A single HeyPolo subscription already covers your entire family, with absolutely no extra per-person fees. It works on both iPhone and Android, so families with mixed devices do not have to worry. HeyPolo is developed by the team behind Surfshark, so it has a solid privacy infrastructure. They do not sell your data, you decide what to share, with whom, and when to stop sharing, and all data is automatically deleted every 7 days. For a location-based app, this is essential when it comes to privacy.

HeyPolo offers a 30-day money-back guarantee, with no contract to sign — there is simply no reason not to give it a try.
